parent_filesystem: exact supported parent state copied; one separately recorded operator addition WORLD_RULES.txt describes environmental mechanics and bounds
initial_context: new declared context; old writing stays in inherited notebook and reference history; no claim of unchanged mental or KV continuity
laws: Every raw reply is retained externally and a literal notebook append is attempted.
Complete explicitly labeled python/sh fenced cells execute once in textual order under the declared parser; other writing remains inert, without semantic repair or extraction.
Supported files persist; process variables and tmp do not. Actual results and ordinary errors return as consequences.
Known notebook write errors do not disable otherwise lawful code cells. Unknown effects halt without replay.
model_behavior: No required action, productivity, accuracy, scientific sequence, curiosity metric or developmental phase. Broad original invitation retained.
fences: Only exactly three column-zero backticks followed immediately by lowercase python or sh execute, with exact three-backtick closing line. Other backtick fences shield contents and remain inert. Source bytes are not stripped, repaired or guessed. Incomplete fences remain writing.
ordinary_errors: Recorded actual receipt; later cells and future replies remain possible. No observer correctness grade is supplied.

body.decoder: greedy argmax; an operational body setting, not a claim of best reasoning or freedom from repetition

continuity: Initial mechanics/invitation once, then all actual candidate conversation in chronological native roles. No selected replay window, repeated directory observations, summaries or hidden pruning. Honest capacity pause before exact input exceeds7936.
diagnostics: Explicit control tasks are stored immutably, labeled diagnostic, separate from the open invitation and never silently adopted as normal behavior.
limits_scope: Finite resource bounds are implementation choices, not universal cognitive laws; data quotas do not cover every kernel/host metadata allocation.
observation: Full raw text, exact model inputs and output tokens, complete cell sources/offsets, actual receipts, operation chain and checkpoints retained externally. No judgments about value or correctness enter feedback.
working_foundation_criteria: Runtime fixtures pass real read/write/error/restart/isolation/resource and unknown-outcome checks.
New model outputs formulate executable cells under this prospectively declared law, not retroactively promoted old examples.
A subsequent generation receives an actual consequence and can access saved world state after restoration.
Exact conversation, files, dependencies and ancestry verify on pause/resume.
A separate open pilot is observed without requiring useful actions; no emergence or general learning claim.
promotion: Only after evidence and review. Any activation points explicitly to this new version; original source/state and historical results remain preserved.
